why: RJ-L70 (orientation-crop OC-7), pending #3756 and waits on OC-8: stands up a sideways 4000x3000 scan (no orientation tag) with Rotate Right, crops it 4:5 portrait and exports a 3000x3750 JPEG whose top row is the scan's left column. The trap: 4:5 on the landscape original gives 5:4, or export ignores the turn. The CLI's Library also has no JPEG import or export yet; LibraryOrientationTests runs these steps on Linux.
